* Address structure. Imbeds a URI and adds a display name. * *@author M. Ranganathan

methods.name: public HostPort getHostPort()
methods.comment:
Get the host port portion of the address spec.
     *@return host:port in a HostPort structure.

methods.name: public int getPort()
methods.comment:
Get the port from the imbedded URI. This assumes that a SIP URL
     * is encapsulated in this address object.
     *
     *@return the port from the address.
     *

methods.name: public String getUserAtHostPort()
methods.comment:
Get the user@host:port for the address field. This assumes
     * that the encapsulated object is a SipUri.
     *
     *
     *@return string containing user@host:port.

methods.name: public String getHost()
methods.comment:
Get the host name from the address.
     *
     *@return the host name.

methods.name: public void removeParameter(String parameterName)
methods.comment:
Remove a parameter from the address.
     *
     *@param parameterName is the name of the parameter to remove.

methods.name: public String encode()
methods.comment:
* Encode the address as a string and return it.
     * @return String canonical encoded version of this address.

methods.name: public int getAddressType()
methods.comment:
* Get the address type;
     * @return int

methods.name: public void setAddressType(int atype)
methods.comment:
* Set the address type. The address can be NAME_ADDR, ADDR_SPEC or
     * WILD_CARD
     *
     * @param atype int to set
     *

methods.name: public String getDisplayName()
methods.comment:
* get the display name
     *
     * @return String
     *

methods.name: public void setDisplayName(String displayName)
methods.comment:
* Set the displayName member
     *
     * @param displayName String to set
     *

methods.name: public void setAddess(javax.sip.address.URI address)
methods.comment:
* Set the address field
     *
     * @param address SipUri to set
     *

methods.name: public int hashCode()
methods.comment:
* hashCode impelmentation
     *

methods.name: public boolean equals(Object other)
methods.comment:
* Compare two address specs for equality.
     *
     * @param other Object to compare this this address
     *
     * @return boolean
     *

methods.name: public boolean hasDisplayName()
methods.comment:
return true if DisplayName exist.
     *
     * @return boolean

methods.name: public void removeDisplayName()
methods.comment: remove the displayName field

methods.name: public boolean isSIPAddress()
methods.comment:
Return true if the imbedded URI is a sip URI.
     *
     * @return true if the imbedded URI is a SIP URI.
     *

methods.name: public URI getURI()
methods.comment:
Returns the URI address of this Address. The type of URI can be
     * determined by the scheme.
     *
     * @return address parmater of the Address object

methods.name: public boolean isWildcard()
methods.comment: This determines if this address is a wildcard address. That is * Address.getAddress.getUserInfo() == *; * * @return true if this name address is a wildcard, false otherwise.

methods.name: public void setURI(URI address)
methods.comment:
Sets the URI address of this Address. The URI can be either a
     * TelURL or a SipURI.
     *
     * @param address - the new URI address value of this NameAddress.

methods.name: public void setUser(String user)
methods.comment:
Set the user name for the imbedded URI.
     *
     *@param user -- user name to set for the imbedded URI.

methods.name: public void setWildCardFlag()
methods.comment:
Mark this a wild card address type.
     * Also set the SIP URI to a special wild card address.
